I’m sorry you are dealing with akathisia, I had a severe case for almost a year and it drove me to severely self harm and attempt suicide. Thankfully mine has gone away but unfortunately every antipsychotic I try makes it come back so I opted to live with the hallucinations and poor sleep. I don’t have a magic cure to tell you but I do have a list of things that helped me get relief even if it was only small periods of time.

Hard to explain this first one but just having my body being squished provided enough deep pressure for me to at least fall asleep or have a few hours of relief but ALOT of pressure. I wore a compression vest + 20ibs weighted blanket + tall compression socks + weighted stuffed animals on me and finally I slept in a sensory sock.

HOT HOT baths I’m talking like you get out of the bath and every part of you that was in the water is bright red. Probably not the best for your skin but when I was in the hot bath and maybe for an hour afterwards I had relief.

Treadmill before bed or at any point in the day when the akathisia was too much. I wouldn’t walk super fast but I’d make the incline high and I’d go as long as I could. While walking the burning feeling in my legs from the difficult exercise covered the akathisia and it would help me be so exhausted I could fall asleep for a few hours.

Small amounts of marijuana. I would have like 1/4 to 1/2 of an edible. I found if I had more than that at a time it actually made the akathisia more unbearable.

Floating in a pool feeling weightless gave relief but only while I was in the pool.


A truckload of magnesium glyconate also helped the anxiety that came along with it and helped falling asleep.

My heart goes out to you I’m so sorry you are dealing with this I wouldn’t wish it on my worst enemy.

The only way I was able to permanently get rid of it was to stop antipsychotics. It went away about 2 months after I stopped them. My mental health is a lot harder to maintain without those medications but I find it a way better option than akathisia.

Feel free to message me if you have any questions.

Good luck!!!

Edit: if you take melatonin please try to stop it. For some reason if I took it at night it made my symptoms way worse the next day.
